The provided text aligns with the **Supernatural Detective** or **Occult Noir** genre. Key thematic elements include the juxtaposition of mundane police procedure (glancing at a crime scene) with supernatural or ancient mysteries (ritualistic killing, forgotten symbols, occult history). The atmosphere is established through sensory details (incense masking death) and internal reaction (chilled to the bone), which are hallmarks of the genre's focus on mystery, dread, and hidden histories.
